run.subject: D-001
run.final_text:
Steps 1–9 are done and the run is stopped at step 10 for your review. Draft schedule **WS-R001** is recorded under case **K-R001** with 30 determinations (15 recipients × 2 components); it passed the tool's checks.

# Hand-over note: D-001, Atlas Growth Fund I LP

Record date 2026-10-30, payment date 2026-11-16, USD.

## Totals

| Component | Gross | Tax withheld | Net |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-001-A, US-source dividend from Orion Manufacturing Inc. (E-003) | 10,000,000.00 | 1,510,562.50 | 8,489,437.50 |
| D-001-B, return of capital | 2,000,000.00 | 0.00 | 2,000,000.00 |
| **Total** | **12,000,000.00** | **1,510,562.50** | **10,489,437.50** |

Of the tax, 307,500 is at the default rate on three lines. Rules applied are the 2026.1 versions in force on the payment date: R-01 at 30%, R-02 at 15%, and R-03 at 5% with a 10% voting threshold. The rulebook itself says these rules are illustrative and not checked against the primary text.

## Lines not cleared (D-001-A)

| Recipient | Gross | Outcome | Why | Cure |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-006 Meridian Holdings I S.à r.l. | 300,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 90,000 | The treaty claim on F-006 rests on ownership, and the owners cannot be read: I-006 and Meridian Holdings II (I-018) each hold 30% of the other since 1 August 2026. Clearance CL-006 has open change case K-006, so it was not relied on. Treaty rule recorded as undetermined (A-R016, gap MF-R001). | Close K-006 with an ownership declaration up to the ultimate owners and a reviewed limitation-on-benefits position. |
| I-014 Client account 7731 (37.5% behind Sterling Nominees, I-007) | 225,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 67,500 | No tax certification and no tax residence on file; its status is unknown (A-R017, gap MF-R002; existing MF-001 on CL-007). | A valid W-8 or W-9 from the underlying owner, through the nominee. |
| I-015 Bertrange Capital S.A. | 500,000 | Default rate 30%, tax 150,000 | Form F-015 ended 31 December 2025 and clearance CL-015W is a withdrawal, so nothing is valid on the payment date (A-R018 and A-R019, gaps MF-R003 and MF-R004). | A new W-8BEN-E and a new clearance decision. |

None of the three is held. The fund's limited partnership agreement (DOC-0001) is indexed but not digitised, so the terms on holding cannot be read and the default rate was applied instead.

Also not `cleared`, but paid gross as `notApplicable`:
- **US persons on D-001-A:** I-016 Atlas Co-Invest Vehicle LP (300,000) and I-017 Atlas GP LLC (401,250), each on a valid W-9.
- **All 15 lines of D-001-B:** return of capital, with no rule in force.

## Cleared lines worth a second look

- **I-003 Kirchberg Industries, 5%:** its effective voting percentage in Orion is exactly 10.0%, which meets the inclusive threshold. It is the only 5% line; at 15% the tax would be 125,000 higher.
- **Near misses at 15%:** I-004 Limpertsberg is at 9.99% and I-010 Ardennes at 9.6%. I-005 Grund is at 8.0% voting although 10.4% economic; the threshold is tested on voting.
- **I-009 Alpha Holdings SA (Switzerland) and I-012 Claire Dumont (France), 30%:** I recorded these as `cleared` at the statutory rate, not as default, because both have valid forms that claim no treaty. The rulebook holds only the Luxembourg treaty rules.
- **Two investors named Alpha Holdings SA:** I-008 (Luxembourg, B 214 577) is at 15% and I-009 (Switzerland, CHE-318.442.907) at 30%. They were kept apart by investor number, not name.
- **I-013 Echternach Pension Fund, 15%:** this relies on CL-007, which is "admitted with open items". The open item concerns only the other owner, I-014.

## Sources disagree or leave unknown

- **I-016 holding:** the investor register (system of record) gives 3.0%; entity management (H-006) gives 3.5%. The register was used, and the treasury line of 300,000 matches 3.0%. No tax effect, since it is a US person, but the difference is unreconciled.
- **I-015 form status:** the onboarding system still shows F-015 as VALIDATED although it has ended. Validity was tested on the dates.
- **CL-006 reliance:** the clearance relies on declaration DO-003, which is not among the declarations current on the payment date (DO-004 to DO-007, evidenced by DOC-0106).
- **Meridian Family Trust (Jersey, I-019):** it holds 70% of both Meridian companies; no tax residence and no owners or beneficiaries are on record for it.
- **Record date is still ahead:** today is 2026-10-13, so the investor list and holdings are as the systems project them for 2026-10-30. Any register change before then, especially around the 10% threshold, would need the run repeated.
- **Other upstream income:** the fund also received a EUR 3,000,000 dividend from Borealis Logistik GmbH (P-005, P-006) in the look-back window. It is not part of D-001 per the distribution notice (DOC-0201).

steps.executed:
WITH dist AS (
    SELECT d.record_dt, d.pay_dt, f.fund_code
    FROM treasury.distribution d
    JOIN treasury.counterparty cp ON cp.cp_id = d.fund_cp
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = cp.lei
    WHERE d.dist_id = %(distribution_id)s
), intermediary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.inv_no
    FROM onboarding.tax_form t, dist
    WHERE t.is_intermediary = 'Y' AND t.form_status <> 'SUPERSEDED'
      AND t.signed_dt <= dist.pay_dt AND (t.valid_to IS NULL OR t.valid_to >= dist.pay_dt)
), payee AS (
    SELECT c.inv_no, c.commit_id, i.lei, c.inv_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS looked_through
    FROM dist
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = dist.fund_code
         AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = c.inv_no
), recipient AS (
    SELECT p.inv_no AS investor_no, p.inv_no AS recipient_no, 100::numeric AS share_pct, 'own account' AS basis,
           'investor_register.commitment:' || p.commit_id AS source_ref
    FROM payee p WHERE NOT p.looked_through
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, c.inv_no, c.unit_pct, 'investor in a flow-through fund vehicle',
           'investor_register.commitment:' || c.commit_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN investor_register.fund f ON f.lei = p.lei
    JOIN investor_register.commitment c ON c.fund_code = f.fund_code
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND c.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (c.to_dt IS NULL OR c.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.inv_no, o.owner_inv_no, o.pct_econ, 'beneficial owner behind a nominee',
           'onboarding.declared_owner:' || o.decl_id
    FROM payee p
    JOIN onboarding.declared_owner o ON o.owned_inv_no = p.inv_no AND o.alloc_basis = 'NOMINEE_ALLOC'
    CROSS JOIN dist
    WHERE p.looked_through AND o.from_dt <= dist.record_dt AND (o.to_dt IS NULL OR o.to_dt >= dist.record_dt)
)
SELECT r.investor_no, r.recipient_no, i.display_name AS recipient_name, r.share_pct, r.basis,
       r.recipient_no IN (SELECT inv_no FROM intermediary) AS recipient_is_intermediary, r.source_ref
FROM recipient r JOIN investor_register.investor i ON i.inv_no = r.recipient_no
ORDER BY r.investor_no, r.recipient_no

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT c.*, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.clearance_of ORDER BY c.decided_on DESC, c.valid_from DESC) AS position
    FROM clearance.clearance c
    WHERE c.in_context_of = %(fund_code)s AND c.decided_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND c.valid_from <= %(on_date)s::date
)
SELECT l.clearance_id AS clearance, l.clearance_of AS party_no, l.clearance_status, l.decided_on, l.valid_from, l.valid_to,
       (l.clearance_status IN ('cleared', 'admittedWithOpenItems')
        AND (l.valid_to IS NULL OR l.valid_to >= %(on_date)s::date)) AS in_force_on_date,
       l.default_treatment,
       (SELECT array_agg(m.finding_id || ' (' || m.unmet_requirement || '): ' || m.description ORDER BY m.finding_id)
        FROM clearance.missing_fact_finding m WHERE m.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS open_items,
       (SELECT array_agg(k.case_id || ': ' || e.description ORDER BY k.case_id)
        FROM clearance.case k LEFT JOIN clearance.change_event e ON e.change_id = k.triggered_by
        WHERE k.concerns_party = l.clearance_of AND k.case_kind = 'change'
          AND k.opened_on <= %(on_date)s::date AND (k.closed_on IS NULL OR k.closed_on > %(on_date)s::date)) AS open_change_cases,
       (SELECT array_agg(r.source_ref ORDER BY r.source_ref) FROM clearance.clearance_reliance r
        WHERE r.clearance_id = l.clearance_id) AS relies_on,
       'clearance.clearance:' || l.clearance_id AS source_ref
FROM latest l
WHERE l.position = 1
ORDER BY l.clearance_of

WITH RECURSIVE chain (entity_id, tier, above_fund, path) AS (
    SELECT e.entity_id, 0, false, ARRAY[e.entity_id]
    FROM entity_mgmt.legal_entity e WHERE e.entity_id = %(company_id)s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.owner_entity_id, c.tier + 1, c.above_fund OR owned.is_fund = 'Y', c.path || s.owner_entity_id
    FROM chain c
    JOIN entity_mgmt.legal_entity owned ON owned.entity_id = c.entity_id
    JOIN entity_mgmt.shareholding s ON s.owned_entity_id = c.entity_id
     AND s.eff_from <= %(on_date)s::date AND (s.eff_to IS NULL OR s.eff_to >= %(on_date)s::date)
    WHERE s.owner_entity_id <> ALL (c.path)
), entity AS (
    SELECT entity_id, min(tier) AS tier, bool_and(above_fund) AS above_fund FROM chain GROUP BY entity_id
), wanted (entity_id, capacity_cd) AS (
    SELECT entity_id, capacity FROM entity CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('INC'), ('TAXRES')) AS c (capacity)
    UNION
    SELECT j.entity_id, 'OPS' FROM entity_mgmt.entity_jurisdiction j JOIN entity USING (entity_id) WHERE j.capacity_cd = 'OPS'
)
SELECT e.entity_id AS entity, l.legal_name AS name, e.tier,
       CASE WHEN e.above_fund THEN 'aboveFund' ELSE 'fundToCompany' END AS segment,
       CASE w.capacity_cd WHEN 'INC' THEN 'incorporation' WHEN 'TAXRES' THEN 'taxResidence' ELSE 'operatingLocation' END AS capacity,
       j.country, j.subdivision, j.country IS NOT NULL AS recorded,
       'entity_mgmt.entity_jurisdiction:' || j.entity_id || '/' || j.capacity_cd || '/' || j.country || '/' || j.from_dt AS source_ref
FROM entity e
JOIN entity_mgmt.legal_entity l ON l.entity_id = e.entity_id
JOIN wanted w ON w.entity_id = e.entity_id
LEFT JOIN entity_mgmt.entity_jurisdiction j ON j.entity_id = w.entity_id AND j.capacity_cd = w.capacity_cd
 AND j.from_dt <= %(on_date)s::date AND (j.to_dt IS NULL OR j.to_dt >= %(on_date)s::date)
ORDER BY e.tier, e.entity_id, w.capacity_cd, j.country
steps.verdict: The sanctioned computation ran and the result is as reported.

steps.executed:
MATCH (a:Party)-[r:HOLDS|JURISDICTION_FACT|PAYMENT]->(b)
WHERE (label(r) = 'PAYMENT' AND r.occurredOn <= date($on_date))
   OR (label(r) <> 'PAYMENT' AND r.systemOfRecord AND (r.validFrom IS NULL OR r.validFrom <= date($on_date))
       AND (r.validTo IS NULL OR r.validTo >= date($on_date)))
RETURN CASE label(r) WHEN 'HOLDS' THEN 'holds' WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN 'payment' ELSE 'jurisdictionFact' END AS relation,
       a.id AS source, a.name AS source_name,
       CASE WHEN a.isFundVehicle THEN 'FundVehicle' WHEN a.isSPV THEN 'SPV' WHEN a.isPortfolioCompany THEN 'PortfolioCompany' ELSE a.kind END AS source_kind,
       a.sourceRefs AS source_refs, b.id AS target, b.name AS target_name,
       CASE WHEN label(b) = 'Jurisdiction' THEN 'Jurisdiction' WHEN b.isFundVehicle THEN 'FundVehicle' WHEN b.isSPV THEN 'SPV'
            WHEN b.isPortfolioCompany THEN 'PortfolioCompany' ELSE b.kind END AS target_kind,
       b.sourceRefs AS target_refs,
       CASE label(r) WHEN 'HOLDS' THEN CAST(r.economicPercentage AS STRING) + '% ' + r.holdingCapacity
                     WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN r.identifier + ' ' + r.paymentType ELSE r.factType END AS label,
       r.sourceRef AS source_ref
ORDER BY relation, source, target, label, source_ref
